decisions.rationale: 'Inherited C3 deficiency' names one specific inherited complement disorder (C3 deficiency) with no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions; Examples 6 and 12

decisions.rationale: 'recurrent infections' is a very general term without a specific disease identity, similar to 'complications' or 'abnormalities'.
'glomerulonephritis' is a family of multiple kidney diseases defined by glomerular inflammation rather than a single specific disease.
'homozygous deficiency of the third component of complement' describes the specific condition of complete C3 deficiency, a qualified disease description rather than a bare general term.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Annotate all Specific Disease mentions; Example 6

decisions.rationale: 'recurrent bacterial infections' refers to a family of multiple specific bacterial infections; the qualifiers 'recurrent' and 'bacterial' do not make it a single specific disease.
decisions.guideline_section: 1. Disease Class definition; What NOT to Annotate 4

decisions.rationale: 'pneumonia' is a single clinically defined disease entity named as a disease.
'mesangiopathic glomerulonephritis' is a specific pathological form of glomerulonephritis with its own definition, so the full phrase is the minimum necessary span.

decisions.rationale: 'C3 deficiency' (first occurrence) is a specific disease with a single definition.

decisions.rationale: 'immune-complex disease' refers to a family of diseases mediated by immune complexes rather than one specific disease.
'severe pyogenic infections' denotes a family of multiple specific pus-forming infections; the severity and pyogenic qualifiers do not make it one specific disease.
